docs.text: Clean Architecture Whether you’re working in .NET, Java, Python, or even JavaScript — the principles you'll learn here are technology-agnostic and apply across languages and frameworks.c 🧱 What Is Clean Architecture? Clean Architecture is a set of software design principles that help you organize your codebase in a way that: Keeps business rules at the center of the application Makes your system easy to test and modify Decouples framework code (like ORM, HTTP servers) from business logic Clean Architecture is about drawing clear boundaries between layers of your application, and ensuring that dependencies always point inward — toward your core logic.
